source: Zhou, Z., Vanacore, K., Thompson, T., St John, J., & Kizilcec, R. (2026). NTO Tutor Move Taxonomy. arXiv:2603.05778v1. Three codes are taken verbatim from Table 1, out of the taxonomy's twenty-eight. OTHER_TUTOR_MOVE and NONE are this project's. Each code's meaning is stated here in this project's own words; the authors' wording is in their Table 1.
unit_of_analysis: One tutor turn: the turn immediately before a problem-solving episode that a student's turn opens. Only that one turn is examined.
note_on_independence: A separate layer with its own version, its own provenance card and its own agreement figure. It does not merge with, redefine, or get crosswalked against the episode codes, and no index is computed across the two layers. It classifies a tutor turn; it never labels an episode.
note_on_none: NONE means the tutor's turn contains no move that invites, directs or supplies the next piece of work. It does NOT mean 'none of the three named codes': every other such move is OTHER_TUTOR_MOVE. Only NONE licenses the report sentence 'with no prompt in the turn before it'. [OURS: with three codes and NONE alone, NONE would absorb next-step prompts, hints and probing, and the report sentence would be false exactly where it is most often said.]

provenance.citation: Zhou, Vanacore, Thompson, St John & Kizilcec (2026). NTO Tutor Move Taxonomy. arXiv:2603.05778v1.
provenance.corpus: Authentic one-to-one tutoring transcripts from multiple providers. The authors do not report corpus counts.
provenance.agreement_as_reported: Two veteran teachers coded with the full scheme. Cohen's kappa was .65 in the first round and .78 in the second round, after clarifications and minor alterations to the scheme.
provenance.status: An arXiv preprint. The authors describe the taxonomy as a living framework that will evolve as more data is ingested.
provenance.not_validated_on: The use of a three-code subset, with two codes of this project's added, rather than the full twenty-eight. The authors' agreement is for the full scheme; a subset's reliability is not established by it.
provenance.in_this_project: No agreement has been established for this layer in this project. It reaches a family's report only when its own agreement reaches 0.61.

codes.name: Asks for an explanation
codes.definition: The tutor asks the student to explain their own reasoning, an action they took, or something they know.
include: asking the student to say how they got a result
asking the student to put what they know into words
exclude: asking for the next step without asking for an explanation (OTHER_TUTOR_MOVE)
asking the student to fix an error (PROMPTING_SELF_CORRECTION)

codes.name: Asks for a correction
codes.definition: The tutor asks the student to find and fix a mistake of their own, without giving the correct version.
include: pointing out that something is off and asking the student to check it
asking the student to look again at a step that went wrong
exclude: saying only that a response is wrong, with no request (NONE)

codes.name: Gives the answer
codes.definition: The tutor supplies the solution or result outright, without the steps that lead to it.
include: stating the result of a step the student was working on
exclude: explaining how to do a step (OTHER_TUTOR_MOVE)
confirming a result the student already gave (NONE)

codes.name: Another prompt or direction
codes.origin: [OURS] Covers every other move in the Zhou et al. (2026) taxonomy that invites, directs or supplies the next piece of work.
codes.definition: Any other tutor move that invites, directs or supplies content for what comes next.
include: explaining a concept or a procedure
exclude: a turn that makes no such move (NONE)

codes.name: No prompt
codes.definition: The tutor's turn contains no move that invites, directs or supplies the next piece of work.
include: confirming or rejecting a response with no request attached
repeating or rephrasing what the student said, with no question
exclude: any question or instruction about the work, however light (OTHER_TUTOR_MOVE or a named code)
